recipe.name: Bombae Rita
recipe.description: A vibrant Indian-inspired Margarita marrying crisp tequila with fresh watermelon and tangy, sour kokum, balanced by a savoury spiced rim.
steps: Moisten half the rim of a rocks glass and coat it with the house spice mix.
Add the Camino Blanco, fresh watermelon juice, kokum syrup, and optional lime juice to a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously for 12 seconds until well chilled.
Strain into the prepared rocks glass over fresh ice.
recipe.garnish: House spice mix rim and a small watermelon wedge
recipe.serving: Served cold in a spice-rimmed rocks glass over fresh cubes.
